ex.en: You have the advantage of a good education.
ex.zh: 你受過良好教育，這是你的優勢。

ex.en: His parents are saving for his college education.
ex.zh: 他的父母在為他的大學教育存錢。

ex.en: He placed emphasis on the importance of education.
ex.zh: 他強調了教育的重要性。

ex.en: The sidebar is displayed on the edge of the page below the site logo.
ex.zh: 側邊欄顯示在頁面邊緣、網站標誌下方。

ex.en: Don't stand too close to the edge of the cliff.
ex.zh: 不要站得離懸崖邊太近。

ex.en: He sat on the edge of the bed.
ex.zh: 他坐在床邊。

ex.en: The company's competitive edge will be eroded if system engineers continue to leave.
ex.zh: 如果系統工程師繼續離職，公司的競爭優勢就會被削弱。

ex.en: Who has the edge now?
ex.zh: 現在誰佔上風？

ex.en: You don't want to be an editor?
ex.zh: 你不想當編輯嗎？

ex.en: She works as an editor at a publishing company.
ex.zh: 她在出版社當編輯。

ex.en: I write code in a simple text editor.
ex.zh: 我用簡單的文字編輯器寫程式。

ex.en: This photo editor is free to download.
ex.zh: 這款照片編輯軟體可以免費下載。

ex.en: He proposed a reform in the educational system.
ex.zh: 他提議改革教育制度。

ex.en: It is essential that every child have the same educational opportunities.
ex.zh: 每個孩子都應該享有相同的教育機會。

ex.en: I found the field trip very educational.
ex.zh: 我覺得這次校外教學很有教育意義。

ex.en: Some people say that cartoons on television are educational in themselves.
ex.zh: 有人說電視卡通本身就有教育意義。

ex.en: People are more educated now than they used to be.
ex.zh: 現在的人教育程度比以前高。

ex.en: Mr. Ito is a highly educated man.
ex.zh: 伊藤先生是個受過高等教育的人。

ex.en: He is proud of having been educated in the United States.
ex.zh: 他以自己在美國受教育為傲。

ex.en: We need to educate the public about recycling.
ex.zh: 我們需要向大眾宣導資源回收。

ex.en: The campaign aims to educate customers about online safety.
ex.zh: 這項活動旨在讓顧客了解網路安全。

ex.en: Is there a paperback edition of this book?
ex.zh: 這本書有平裝版嗎？

ex.en: Which is more complete, the first edition or the second?
ex.zh: 第一版和第二版，哪一個比較完整？

ex.en: The latest edition of the magazine comes out tomorrow.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌的最新一期明天出刊。

ex.en: Edit your work better before you submit it, it's sloppy.
ex.zh: 交出去之前把你的作品好好修改一下，太馬虎了。

ex.en: It will be able to edit the pictures you don't like, then print them out.
ex.zh: 它可以修改你不喜歡的照片，然後印出來。

ex.en: Can you edit this video before we post it?
ex.zh: 我們發布前，你可以先剪輯這支影片嗎？

ex.en: Today's editorial criticizes the new tax.
ex.zh: 今天的社論批評新稅制。

ex.en: She writes editorials for a local paper.
ex.zh: 她為一家地方報紙撰寫社論。

ex.en: Bill is on the editorial staff.
ex.zh: 比爾在編輯部工作。

ex.en: The magazine has a small editorial team.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌的編輯團隊很小。
